description: This source file defines an interface for fault-injection transactional grain tests and a concrete implementation of such a grain. The grain manages a transactional state with methods for setting, adding to, retrieving, and deactivating the grain, primarily used for testing fault injection scenarios within Orleans transactions.

classes.name: IFaultInjectionTransactionTestGrain
classes.description: Interface defining methods for fault injection transactional grain testing, including setting, adding, getting, and deactivating the grain.

classes.name: SingleStateFaultInjectionTransactionalGrain
classes.description: Implementation of a transactional grain that manages a single state with fault injection capabilities, supporting set, add, get, and deactivate operations.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously activates the grain, setting up the logger.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the grain's internal value to a new value within a transactional context.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a specified number to the grain's value, with optional fault injection control.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the grain's state.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the grain, marking it for idle cleanup.
